summary.name: LANDR
summary.one_liner: LANDR is an online music production platform offering AI mastering, music distribution to streaming services, sample and plugin libraries, remote collaboration tools, and music courses.
use_cases: Mastering finished tracks to release-ready quality
Distributing music to 150+ streaming and social platforms
Finding royalty-free samples and loops for production
Running remote recording and mix feedback sessions
Learning music production and marketing through courses
Hiring session musicians or industry pros
summary.what_it_does: LANDR provides AI mastering through an online engine, a mastering plugin for DAWs, and a mobile app for managing projects. Its distribution service releases music to over 150 streaming and social platforms, with unlimited releases and the stated claim that music stays live even if the subscription is cancelled. The bundle includes a library of over 3 million royalty-free samples, an online beat maker, and over 70 effects and instrument plugins, including a stem separator and vocal tools. Collaboration features include high-definition DAW audio video chats, a directory of hireable music professionals, and community channels. It also offers over 200 online music courses with quizzes and progress tracking.
notable: Bundles AI mastering, distribution, samples, plugins, and courses in one subscription (LANDR Studio)
Unlimited distribution to 150+ streaming platforms with 100% royalty retention claimed
Mastering plugin runs inside the user's DAW
Stem separation and remote DAW-audio video sessions included
caveats: Paid bundle; the page cites a $4,000 value but does not give a specific price
Samples per year are capped at 2400 under the Studio plan
Exact pricing and plan tiers are not stated on the page text
